deviceBearer.description: Revocable owner/device-bound opaque credential; out-of-band issuance, no public enrollment API.

x-query-constraints: from and to are required and have no defaults
from must not be after to
the inclusive range must not exceed 366 days (366 * 86400000 ms)
conversionTo must be a member of the approved currency registry (confirmed UYU/USD subset)

302.description: Redirect to allowlisted mobile deep link

x-query-constraints: exactly one of code or error must be present
a provider error callback omits code and returns a 302 redirect to the allowlisted route
Location must use the brainia:// scheme and must not contain a token
